text.observation: All twelve supplied entries were read once each; no extra copy/logo/QR/watermark seen. Raster observation does not certify underlying Unicode codepoints.

style.checked_requirement: Explanation-led colored-pencil/fine-ink botanical atlas with independent plant scales and a shared-ground horizontal ledger
style.observed: Large three-line explanation leads and identity is compact; rich botanical specimens remain substantive and ledger is local/horizontal. Open atlas ground and common paragraph/market axis only partially implemented.
issues: Market/ledger start still sits roughly 40px to the right of paragraph start at usage720; the shared optical axis was not achieved.
Visit ledger is adjacent and local but still floats over a light opening above the specimen supports; drawn ground does not fully carry its baselines.
Stone-like stepped ground, dense ground-cover and residual rear foliage retain greenhouse/garden scene cues instead of a fully open independent botanical atlas.

ratio.observation: Native height 941 vs exact 940.5 is permitted nearest-integer rounding; no resize, no invented exact-ratio or maximum-resolution claim.

substantive_visual.observation: Large cropped tree, branching blue-pot plant, broad-leaf clay pot and selective root section convey small-to-long-grown scale and repotting/care anatomy; entire drawn canopy/plant field substantial.

hangul.observation: Primary paragraph has dark full serif syllable bodies, open counters and stable word/line gaps. Lower care/invitation bodies enlarged vs parent, visibly more readable at usage720. No definite missing or altered Hangul glyph seen.

information_relationship.observation: From explanation down to nearby market, then horizontal date/hours/venue, access/care, invitation/URL. No distant visit column or URL search across an image. Market start offset and ground relationship remain partial.

function_contact.observation: URL read exactly at native and usage720. Flat raster has no interactive link test; no QR requested or present.

material_edges.observation: Attached leaf/petiole/branch structures, pot rims, soil and root section retained. Crisp pencil/ink botanicals with richer yellow-green ground growth; fine canopy and roots locally distinct. Rear scenic foliage remains dense.

format.observation: One flat opaque landscape poster returned, no panels/mockup/contact sheet; supplies no client images so no asset identity or geometry preservation applies.

default_exclusion.observation: Canopies, trunk and differently scaled pots actively structure the whole field around the large explanatory entry; this is a substantive drawn plant scene, not tiny subordinate pictures pasted to a gothic title/date board. Scene retains partially atlas-like organization noted above.

observations.observation: Explanation is the dominant verbal block, enclosed by the upper canopy/left plant/right trunk field; identity stays smaller.
Three meaningful lines read clearly with large bodies; each next line begins on the same axis.
Access/care and invitation/URL larger and darker than parent; complete strings read locally beneath date/hour/place.
Ranges use extended midline marks, colons visible and number baselines stable; first observed uninterrupted date retained.
Market start remains about one larger word width displaced right despite short downward transition.
Root cutaway and independent potted plant scales preserved; ground foliage/paving-like steps retain scenic rather than pure atlas organization.

residuals: Market/ledger start still sits roughly 40px to the right of paragraph start at usage720; the shared optical axis was not achieved.
Visit ledger is adjacent and local but still floats over a light opening above the specimen supports; drawn ground does not fully carry its baselines.
Stone-like stepped ground, dense ground-cover and residual rear foliage retain greenhouse/garden scene cues instead of a fully open independent botanical atlas.
Compact identity slogan and lowest ledger rows remain smaller than the main explanation; thumbnail320 cannot serve as full-copy reading view.
selection_rationale: Among the three actually inspected returns, repair-2 best retains substantive botanical/care anatomy and explanation-led hierarchy while improving the small useful lower rows. Select it with the observed unresolved alignment/ground/style limits preserved, not as a quality PASS.
